newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks gain in very light trading.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks gain in very light trading.

text.p: Greek shares rose in early Tuesday trading, helped by blue chip gains, but trading volume was dramatically low, dealers said.
The Athens general index was up 0.52 percent or 7.95 points at 1,543.64 from Monday's 1,535.69 close after 25 minutes of trade.
Turnover was 0.9 billion drachmas on volume of 0.3 million shares.
Advancers led decliners 66 to 40 with 25 shares unchanged on 131 traded. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
